contract.cleanup: Open all finite gates even on assertion failure; signal-stop unfinished pipes; join original pipe and callback promises; release manual owners; prove readable/writable terminal states with closed promises; cancel/abort only still-open local resources; release probe owners. Owned supervisor teardown remains mandatory.
contract.distinctness: X013 has signal fanout but no independently held write, sink-abort acknowledgment and source-cancel acknowledgment. S020 covers queued writer close, not pipe shutdown fanout.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(pipe.status, 'pending', 'pipe stays pending during held write');
t.same(abortReason, reason, 'sink receives original signal reason');
t.same(cancelReason, reason, 'source receives original signal reason');
t.locked(source, sink, 'both locks retained during cleanup actions');
t.equal(pipe.status, 'pending', 'source cancel completion is still required');
t.same(result.reason, reason, 'successful cleanup preserves signal reason');
t.deep([aborts, cancels], [1, 1], 'each cleanup action runs exactly once');
t.equal(events.includes('abort-done') && events.includes('cancel-done'), true, 'both asynchronous cleanup actions joined');
t.unlocked(source, sink, 'cleanup completion releases both locks');

contract.oracle: All literal assertions execute and pass; no pending promise or public lock remains after joined cleanup.
